description.from:
As a dashboard user, I want a dispatched evaluation to retain one evaluation identity from submission through completion, so that realtime task state, progress, results, and terminal outcome appear on the evaluation I started.

Feature: Stable evaluation identity for dispatched runs

Scenario: A feedback evaluation completes successfully
Given the dashboard has created an evaluation and a task targeting that evaluation
When a worker executes the task
Then the worker updates that same evaluation record
And the task and evaluation both become completed
And the dashboard displays the terminal outcome and execution progress on the requested evaluation

Scenario: A feedback evaluation fails
Given the dashboard has created an evaluation and a task targeting that evaluation
When the worker cannot execute the evaluation
Then the worker records the failure on that same evaluation and task
And the dashboard displays the failure rather than an announced pending state

Out of scope: a UI-only status fallback, duplicate evaluation records, or provider-specific dispatch behavior.
description.to:
As a dashboard user, I want a dispatched evaluation task to show its real execution state and progress in the local dashboard, so that I can verify the portable command worker experience end to end.

Feature: Local dashboard observes evaluation task execution

Scenario: A feedback evaluation completes successfully
Given the dashboard has created a feedback-evaluation task
And the local dispatcher claims that task
When the worker executes the evaluation
Then the task transitions from pending to running to completed
And task stages report execution progress when the command supports progress tracking
And the local dashboard reflects those updates without manual reload

Scenario: A feedback evaluation fails
Given the dashboard has created a feedback-evaluation task
When the worker cannot execute the evaluation
Then the task becomes failed with its captured error
And the local dashboard reflects the failure without manual reload

Out of scope: changing the established model in which the evaluation command creates its evaluation record and links it to the dispatched task.

title.from: Keep dashboard evaluation identity stable through execution
title.to: Show dispatched evaluation task progress in local dashboard proof
